title: Host test-check warnings ask to investigate or rerun although a valid current registered record already exists
outcome: The host's test-check warnings never ask an agent to investigate or rerun a test for an item that already has a received, current registered verification record on unchanged input; when such a record exists, the warning names it instead.
acceptance: When an ordinary check for a test-launcher command closes Unknown because the turn ended before its end was observed, and a registered run launched by that same command in that turn settles with a received verification record for the current claim, the host's delivery to the agent names the registered run and record as the outcome and does not present the ordinary Unknown as an unresolved problem; when no such registered settlement exists, the existing Unknown warning is unchanged.

When a recognised test runs in one claim's named root, the reminder that another bound item in the same session gets no credit and should run its test next turn is not given if that other item already holds a received registered verification record whose source matches its current, unchanged input; it is given unchanged otherwise.
Tests cover both warnings in both branches and assert the delivered wording; no credit is derived from the ordinary check or moved across roots.
